title: Lipschitz saturation of toric singularities in any dimension
summary: We describe the semigroup of the Lipschitz saturation of a complex analytic toric singularity in arbitrary dimension. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for a monomial in the normalization to belong to the Lipschitz saturation, in terms of Newton polyhedra and lattice conditions, and deduce a finite algorithm to compute it. We also show that, in dimension greater than two, Campillo's notion of presaturation differs from the Lipschitz saturation, even for complex singularities.
